arguments.content:
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Create a one-hour team meeting event for next Wednesday at 3 PM (UTC)."""
from datetime import date, datetime, timedelta, timezone
import uuid

TODAY = date.today()
WEDNESDAY = 2  # weekday(): Monday=0 ... Sunday=6

# Next Wednesday strictly after today
days_ahead = (WEDNESDAY - TODAY.weekday()) % 7
if days_ahead == 0:
    days_ahead = 7
next_wed = TODAY + timedelta(days=days_ahead)

start = datetime(next_wed.year, next_wed.month, next_wed.day, 15, 0, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
end = start + timedelta(hours=1)
now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)


def fmt(dt):
    return dt.strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")


uid = f"team-meeting-{next_wed.isoformat()}-{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}@calendar-skill"

ics_lines = [
    "BEGIN:VCALENDAR",
    "VERSION:2.0",
    "PRODID:-//Calendar Skill//Team Meeting//EN",
    "CALSCALE:GREGORIAN",
    "METHOD:PUBLISH",
    "BEGIN:VEVENT",
    "UID:" + uid,
    "DTSTAMP:" + fmt(now),
    "DTSTART:" + fmt(start),
    "DTEND:" + fmt(end),
    "SUMMARY:Team Meeting",
    "DESCRIPTION:One-hour team meeting starting at 15:00 UTC. Timezone: UTC.",
    "STATUS:CONFIRMED",
    "SEQUENCE:0",
    "BEGIN:VALARM",
    "ACTION:DISPLAY",
    "DESCRIPTION:Team meeting starts in 15 minutes",
    "TRIGGER:-PT15M",
    "END:VALARM",
    "END:VEVENT",
    "END:VCALENDAR",
]

ics_content = "\r\n".join(ics_lines) + "\r\n"

output_path = "team_meeting.ics"
with open(output_path, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as f:
    f.write(ics_content)

print(f"Event created for {next_wed} (Wednesday), 15:00-16:00 UTC")
print(f"Written to {output_path}")
